title: Recursive supported-dependency discovery
description:
Implement version-aware recursive discovery for supported local bundle dependencies: Markdown and HTML element URLs, including script `src`, plus CSS `@import` and `url()`. Resolve paths by normalized components, distinguish relative and root-relative edges, reject repository escape, detect cycles, and retain enough edge data for before/after reachability validation. Scan pinned roots and their supported closure from commit-resolved storage content. Detect the binding dynamic-loading set textually—`fetch(`, `import(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `new Worker(`, `importScripts(`, URL-bearing `data-*`, and relative static module `import`/`export ... from`/`require`—without executing or guessing JavaScript. Existing snapshot-export callers remain unchanged because this is a new recursive path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Discovery reaches an HTML to sibling CSS to nested figure chain and recursively follows CSS `@import` and `url()` targets; script-element `src` is a supported static edge.
- [hard] REQ-02: Cycles terminate deterministically, repository escapes are rejected, and local-path-bearing constructs from the complete binding dynamic-loading set are reported as unsupported edges by textual matching only.
- [hard] REQ-03: A pinned root is scanned from commit-resolved content and emits informational `(path, canonical full OID)` dependencies; `CommitNotFound` or commit-path `NotFound` for the root or a supported dependency produces `pinned-read-failed`, blocks the target, and never falls back to working-tree bytes.
